id: \rJasmine: You came all the way up here to challenge me? I'm sorry, but my Amphy is sick.
en: \rJasmine: You came all the way up here to challenge me? I'm sorry, but my Amphy is sick.
it: \rJasmine: Sei salito fin quassù per sfidarmi? Mi dispiace, ma il mio Amphy è malato.

id: \rIf he had some medicine from Cianwood City I'm sure he would recover in no time.
en: \rIf he had some medicine from Cianwood City I'm sure he would recover in no time.
it: \rSe avesse una medicina da Fiorlisopoli, sono certa che si riprenderebbe in un attimo.

id: \rI can't leave his side. If you get it for me I promise you a Gym battle.
en: \rI can't leave his side. If you get it for me I promise you a Gym battle.
it: \rNon posso lasciarlo da solo. Se me la porti, ti prometto una lotta in Palestra.
